purpose: rank actual Maya readings and availability by relevance to source-grounded falsifiable birth-day claims, calendar calculations and original astronomy
reading_policy: First three source classes: living practitioner testimony, original codex, and independent scholarly commentary. Every source distinction and page anchor preserved; do not equate astronomical table with natal prediction.
book_selection_non_purchase: No purchases, copying of copyrighted full texts, or paid access authorized by this catalog.
